text: Activity by Unfunny_Curator proposing to detect, analyse and chat about artspeak: the buzzwords of the art world. A specialised, characteristic language that shapes the way we relate to exhibitions and art projects, whether as art-world agents or as cultural consumers.

We analysed various room sheets, detecting, storing and debating our findings. We also dissected some statements or project texts written by the participants themselves. And finally, we dumped all the caught buzzwords into chat gpt and asked it to write the definitive room text.
Activity linked to the MURAD master's programme and with the participation of Grup d'Estudi.
